description: A purple T‑shirt lies on a green bed sheet in front of you, with pillows propped against the headboard. The right hand reaches in to grab and open the shirt while the left hand moves in to help; together they lift and shake it out, lay it flat, then fold one side inward and smooth it, fold the other side inward to make a long rectangle, and finally fold the bottom up into a compact stack before both hands release the two-hand object.
